column3: 9A. Notwithstanding anything contained in
the  resolutions  passed  by  Parliament  under
paragraph (2) of Article 150 of the Constitution
during the period so far in year 2022, making
financial  provision  for  expenditure  for  the
period  commencing  on  January  1,  2022  and
ending on December 31, 2022 all such sums of
money which have been expended  during the
respective periods, out of the moneys allocated
by  such  resolutions  to  any  programme
appearing  under  any  head  specified  in  such
resolutions  and  any  moneys  which  have  not
been  expended  on  the  day  immediately
preceding  the  date  of  commencement  of  this
Act  shall  for  all  purposes  be  deemed  to  be
included  in  the  moneys  allocated  to  the
corresponding Programme appearing under the
corresponding Head, as specified in the First
Schedule to this Act.”.
